d.ko: In a world filled with yōkai, a surging dark power has overshadowed a Japanese town. A group of 2 developers have produced a Japanese pixel adventure game to tell a tale that dates back to the Heisei era...In the name of dreams and passion.
d.en: In a world filled with yōkai, a surging dark power has overshadowed a Japanese town. A group of 2 developers have produced a Japanese pixel adventure game to tell a tale that dates back to the Heisei era...In the name of dreams and passion.
d.zh: 暗潮涌动的日本小镇，诡异多彩的妖怪世界，如烟花般绮丽的平成怪谈物语……两人团队打造的日式像素风奇幻冒险游戏，致敬自由、浪漫与梦想。
